## Wiki front door: `trie index` generates <triefacts.root>/README.md… — 2026-07-25 (parent 0455d3a4aec1)

Adds a `trie index` command that generates `<triefacts.root>/README.md` as a deterministic wiki front door for the triefact tree. Three new symbols in `trie/index.py` do the work:

- `build_index` — renders the markdown: a managed marker, public entry points ranked by inbound-reference count with one-liners and links, and a per-directory file TOC built from front-matter descriptions; skips the digest-archive directory and the README itself.
- `write_index` — writes the result to disk; returns `None` when no triefact tree exists yet.
- `_file_descriptions` — single-pass collector of front-matter descriptions over the tree.

In `trie/cli.py`, `index_cmd` exposes the command manually, and `_refresh_index_quietly` provides advisory regeneration (exceptions silently swallowed) called by `_run_full_pass` and `_run_incremental_sync` after every successful sync. `_triefact_pathspecs` in `session_diff` now also excludes `README.md` from digest evidence.
